title: 18 would you rather questions for couples

items.text: Talk only in memes *or* only in voice notes for a week?
Read their mind for a day *or* swap bodies for a day?
Relive your first date *or* skip ahead to your tenth anniversary?
Always cook *or* always do the dishes?
A surprise trip *or* one you plan together?
Never argue again *or* never be bored again?
Matching tattoos *or* matching outfits for a week?
Flowers for no reason *or* a playlist made just for you?
Be famous together *or* rich and completely unknown?
Adopt a dog *or* adopt a cat together?
Go back to the day you met *or* jump five years ahead?
Share all your passwords *or* share one toothbrush?
A love letter every week *or* a song written about you?
Live by the beach *or* up in the mountains?
A day with their family *or* them a day with yours?
Always know what they’re thinking *or* what they want for dinner?
Fall in love all over again *or* never have to?

slides.title: Save this *for when you’re bored together.*
slides.sub: Answer all 18, then compare. Screenshots encouraged.
